g.text: The three ports that make Swarm tick
Every node must reach every other node on these, and ONLY these. Keep them off the public Internet.
blue = control plane (Raft between managers too)
green = the ONLY port meant for outsiders
Workers start the 2377 connection to a manager, so a worker behind NAT can join. 7946 and 4789 are symmetric: any node may start them. Tested: a manager listens on
